roadmaps.pathTitle: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst — Forecasting & Incentive Systems (IC)
sampleItems: Complete dbt Learn: 'dbt Fundamentals' modules on models/tests (1–2 modules) and apply tests to one commission calc query (use existing SQL snippets).
Set up a GitHub repo and push a minimal dbt project or a well-organized SQL folder with CTEs and a README (include one sample dataset snapshot).
Write 2 short README sections: 'commission_engine_before.md' and 'commission_engine_after.md' summarizing the before/after mechanics and metrics.

roadmaps.pathTitle: SDR Team Lead / Frontline Sales Lead
sampleItems: Draft a one‑page 90‑day pilot: objective, success metrics (activity + outcome), weekly cadence, escalation plan and two pilot mentees' learning goals.
Define 3–5 KPIs for the pilot (e.g., dials/day, qualified leads w/in 14 days, conversion to SQL, pipeline value) and target improvements (baseline → goal).
Create a 10‑slide / 1‑page slide deck and a 20‑minute script to request a pilot approval meeting with your manager (use concrete baseline metrics from Brightloop).

roadmaps.pathTitle: Entry Frontend Engineer — startup product team (React + TypeScript)
sampleItems: Define a concise product: single-page dashboard or small CRUD app relevant to healthtech/analytics (e.g., patient-analytics dashboard with filterable charts). Write a 1-paragraph problem statement.
Create GitHub repo with README, issue backlog (3–6 issues), and an initial project board; pick a license.
Scaffold a React + TypeScript app (Vite or Create React App), set up ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript strict mode, and install React Testing Library + Jest.

roadmaps.pathTitle: Consolidate as Senior Revenue Operations Analyst (formal title & scope) at Ledgerly
sampleItems: Run SQL pulls / Tableau exports to compile: forecast accuracy (quarterly) numbers showing 18%→7% reduction, revenue impact estimates, and dashboard usage logs (viewer list, timestamps) used in board meetings — assemble into a single spreadsheet.
Collect qualitative evidence: 1‑page notes from execs who use the dashboard (email excerpts, meeting minutes), and written feedback from the two junior analysts you mentored (impact on their KPIs).
Map current org context: current informal responsibilities, list of stakeholders for the 3‑person workstream, and any informal handoffs (who escalates what).

roadmaps.pathTitle: Senior Backend Engineer — Payments Platform (Senior IC)
sampleItems: Write a one-page project brief: objective (e.g., 'robust reconciliation run + idempotent retry workflow to reduce manual interventions'), success metrics (incident count, mean time to reconcile, manual tickets/week), and target improvement.

Gather/record baseline metrics from production or mocks (logs, current retry count, manual intervention frequency). If production data is sensitive, create a realistic synthetic baseline based on your experience.
Define minimal deliverables for a demo: API sketch, DB schema change, reconciliation run flow, metrics to emit (Prometheus/Grafana).
Write a 1-page brief: goal (title ask + promotion justification), target metric (revenue or GMV lift), and three candidate experiments to run in the next 3 months.
Do a data & access audit (Snowflake + Looker): list tables/dashboards needed, note missing events/tags, capture current baseline metrics (AOV, conversion, recurring revenue).
Create a simple mapping from experiment KPIs to monthly revenue impact (formula sheet in Google Sheets) to use for hypothesis ROI estimates.

roadmaps.pathTitle: Junior Backend Engineer (Java / Spring Boot) — graduate entry
sampleItems: Decide a focused domain: e.g., Order Management service (create/read/update orders, simple search) — limit scope to 4–6 endpoints and one main aggregate.
Generate Spring Boot project with Spring Initializr (Web, Data JPA, H2/Postgres driver, Actuator), create GitHub repo, add MIT or Apache license and CONTRIBUTING note.
Implement domain model (entities/DTOs), repository interfaces and 2–3 core endpoints (POST /orders, GET /orders/{id}, GET /orders) with basic validation.

roadmaps.pathTitle: Revenue Operations Manager — First-line People Leader (3–6 reports)
sampleItems: Extract and document KPI improvements: pre/post forecast variance (18%→7%), commission engine time-saved (hours/week), dashboard usage metrics — produce 1-page metrics sheet.
Run SQL/Tableau queries to produce charts for executive dashboard slides (revenue accuracy, forecast coverage, commission exceptions).
List current direct/indirect reports and scope you already lead; capture specific examples of decisions you made as lead.
Export a 3–6 month sample from Salesforce (leads, contacts, accounts, activities, opportunities).
Define core KPIs and funnel stages (Lead → MQL → SAL → SQL → Opportunity → Closed-won) in a 1-page doc.
Choose platform: set up Metabase (free cloud/local) or create an Airtable base; sketch dashboard wireframe.

roadmaps.pathTitle: Junior Analytics Engineer / BI Engineer (dbt + Airflow + SQL)
sampleItems: Choose a compact, business-focused dataset (recommend: Kaggle 'Medical Appointment No-Shows' or a synthetic healthtech bookings dataset) and write a one-paragraph business problem (e.g., reduce no-shows / optimize resource utilisation).
Create a public GitHub repo with license and project structure: /dbt, /airflow, /docker-compose.yml, /docs, /notebooks.
Stand up a local Postgres (Docker) and initialize a dbt project (dbt init) configured to that database; add a README 'how to run locally' with exact commands.
